pages.text: Sometimes I really want to splash acid on Granny's annoying stupid black cat! If you ever feel the same way... I have a spell here that summons an acid pool to teach those bullies a lesson!

Hmm, and don't forget to cast it with your Fel Staff, it gives your acid pool a Acid Venom effect! And if that's not enough, try putting on a Crone Robe! Wearing the uniform also increases Acid Venom effect's level by one!
